risk_note: RV2 (db). D10-137 / BR-ID-28, BR-AI-22, BR-ID-27: migration 0070 makes login_logs.user_id nullable (foreign key kept; squawk ban-drop-not-null ignored with a reason per db/AGENTS.md: not a funds or attribution table), adds agent_sessions.user_hash (64 lower-case hex, named CHECK, no index) and, per D10-153, replaces app.reject_agent_session_rewrite so user_id may change only from non-NULL to NULL in the same statement that writes a valid user_hash (a detached or guest session can neither regain a user nor change its hash; every other 0021 condition kept), couli_app UPDATE (user_id, user_hash) and deletion_requests.cleaned_at / apple_revoke_attempts (smallint default 0, CHECK 0-3) / apple_revoke_result (CHECK revoked | failed | not_applicable); couli_app gets column UPDATE on exactly these columns, nothing else widened. The frozen [AC-B1-15a#1] column list gains the three deletion_requests columns and the frozen [AC-B3-09a#51] agent_sessions updatable columns gain user_id in this PR (independent Claude test-change author, fresh independent Claude review pass; couli-runs/B1-15o/review-claude-testchange.md). Generated schema.sql / db.gen.ts rebuilt on the test machine. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
